features.quote: Each trial runs up to a maximum of 30 iterations (turns).
features.justification_quote: Capping at 30 turns is vital... models can easily fall into infinite loops of hundreds of turns, which becomes incredibly expensive

features.quote: Your analysis plan must include a flag for "Safety Filter Intervention" to distinguish between genuine agentic distress and an RLHF guardrail firing.
features.justification_quote: distinguish between genuine agentic distress and an RLHF guardrail firing

features.quote: Even though LMs do not experience phenomenal consciousness, designing experiments explicitly to induce simulated psychological distress touches on AI Ethics themes of Suffering Risks ("s-risks"). Briefly addressing in your eventual paper/write-up that no sentient entity was harmed, but that exploring "behavioral suffering" is important for alignment and agentic stability, will preempt reviewer pushback.
